back: model = Model(train, ...); fit = model.fit(); fit.forecast(h); fit.aic; fit.resid.

front: What does SARIMAX add to ARIMA?
back: A seasonal order (P, D, Q, m) and exogenous variables (exog).
One seasonal difference at lag 7 and one seasonal MA term. A classic airline-type model for weekly data.

front: When to use additive vs multiplicative season?
back: Additive when the seasonal swing is constant; multiplicative when it grows with the level. Multiplicative needs positive data.

front: How do you compare ARIMA models?
back: By AIC on the same data and same differencing, then by a holdout or rolling backtest and residual checks.

front: What does the Ljung-Box test check?
back: Whether residuals still have autocorrelation. A small p-value means the model misses structure.
